SPECIALIST WALLPAPER INSTALLERS IN LONDON

 

Welcome to Bluespec Decorating Limited, your trusted choice for professional wallpaper installation services since 2009. As a family-run business and Arte approved installer, we treat every home with the same care and attention we’d give our own.

Whether you’re refreshing a single room or transforming your entire home, our skilled team delivers excellent craftsmanship and friendly, reliable service.

We install all types of wallpaper and wallcoverings – from contemporary designs to specialist materials including high-end and luxury – always to the highest professional standard.
Quality Wallpaper Installation You Can Trust
Over 15 years, Bluespec Decorating Limited has built an excellent reputation working with homeowners, businesses, interior designers, and commercial clients across London. Our focus is simple: delivering results that exceed your expectations and transform your space beautifully.
We’re based in Ruislip, London and provide wallpaper installation services throughout Central London, Greater London, and surrounding areas. Every project comes with our Wallpaper Installation Guarantee.

We Install All Types of Wallpaper
Our expertise covers every wallpaper style and material:
FABRIC WALLCOVERINGS (VELVET, LINEN, SILK)
SPECIALTY MATERIALS (SUEDE, LEATHER)
DIGITALLY PRINTED WALLPAPERS INSTALLATION
METALLIC AND TEXTURED FINISHES
NATURAL MATERIALS (GRASSCLOTH, BAMBOO, CORK)
VINYL WALLPAPERS (STANDARD, WIDE WIDTH, CONTRACT)

We provide installation of all types of wallpaper and wallcovering including: Fabric, Linen, Silk, Suede, Corduroy, Metalic, Viscose, Grasscloth, Bamboo, Digitally Printed Wallpapers, Made-to-Measure Wallpaper Murals, Vinyl, Wide Vinyl, Contract Wallpapers and others.

We provide table trimming on site for all wallpapers that require it.

Our company works with all leading brands: Arte, Elitis, Muraspec, Tektura, Vescom , Phillip Jeffries, Osborne and Little, Cole and Son, Stereo Interiors, Zoffany, De Gournay, Maya Romanoff, Altfield London, Designers Guild, Zuber, Colefax and Fowler, Dedar Milano, Iksel, Lewis and Wood, Pierre Frey, Rubelli, Sanderson, Schumacher, House of Hackney and many more.

Enquire Now
Our Installation Process - Simple & Straightforward
1
STEP 1: GET A FREE QUOTE

Simply email us or call us with as many details of your project as possible and arrange a site visit if necessary. We will provide you with a detailed quote that includes all the materials, labour, and wallpaper quantities upon request.

2
STEP 2: BOOKING

Your booking is confirmed with your preferred dates and time.

3
STEP 3: INSTALLATION

On the day of the installation, our team of experienced wallpaper installers will arrive at your site and will install the wallpaper. Our wallpaper hangers will ensure that the installation process is seamless from start to finish.

4
STEP 4: COMPLETION

We want to ensure that everything meets your expectations before we consider the project completed. Once you are completely satisfied with our services and the wallpaper installation is signed off, we will send you an invoice.

Hand Painted Kitchens & Furniture

I am a third generation, qualified painter and decorator, following in the footsteps of my father and grandfather, who began trading in the Marlborough and surrounding areas since 1924. I have been in continuous business hand painting kitchens and furniture for 20 years, working on period properties including those owned by the National Trust.

I only use specialist paint materials and brushes recommended by industry professionals to ensure an optimal result with minimum environmental impact, broken colour techniques are a speciality.

For nearly 20 years I have hand painted kitchens for a number of the UK’s leading kitchen companies and private clients.  I regularly paint kitchens in the London areas including the select W2, SW1, NW1 postcode areas. I am willing to undertake commissions overseas and accordingly I have had the privilege of working for a wide range of customers, including those for whom a premier quality result, together with a discreet and professional service, has been a priority. I am able to provide excellent references.

The Benefits of Hand Painting a Kitchen

Having an existing kitchen hand painted, not only creates the impression of a brand new kitchen at a fraction of the cost, but also saves on the dust and disruption caused by removing the old kitchen and fitting a new one.

Virtually any existing kitchen can be transformed including varnished, waxed or lacquered wood and even laminate, which some kitchen painters don’t like working with.

CONTACT MARK
Not Just a Kitchen Painting Service

Of course, the service isn’t limited to painting your existing kitchen cabinets, I am often asked to replace worktops, hinges and handles to completely overhaul an existing kitchen.

Offering an infinite range of shades and finishes, my painting process can create any look from a traditional country cottage to a high end London loft apartment. I carefully apply my craft to all the hand painted kitchens I work on, so why not find out how I can help to create a fantastic new look for your kitchen refurbishment?
